svg.aria-label: What you say: "New project: <idea>. Grill me first.": Questions first, then a plan; "Is it working?": Says if fixes really help; "Premium check": A picky tester finds flaws; "Tiffin box": Packs a chat, loses nothing; "Continue <chat name>": A new chat picks up; "Bigg Boss on <topic>": Finds mistakes that repeat; "Diagnose this": Bug hunt, step by step; "Retro": Lessons go into skills
